newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr on settled NOC demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr on settled NOC demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened steady at 57.10/12 rupees per dollar on Tuesday and dealers said rates were likely to hold at these levels.
"Bankers have submitted their quotes for the demand of $12 million for the import of petroleum products by the Nepal Oil Corp," a dealer said. "A decision is likely to be taken today," he said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 3.50-4.00 percent on Tuesday, a dealer said.
